scope: Retrospective support diagnostic on exposed Classical baseline rows only.
question: Can gap-sign and length be jointly standardized without unsupported TICO cells?
full_partition: 3 gap-sign groups x 4 frozen TICO length bins
predeclared_coarsening_if_sparse: 2 groups (positive vs nonpositive Classical gap) x 2 groups (total tokens <= frozen TICO median 120 vs >120)
decision: A Books-positive/TICO-empty cell makes exact standardization non-estimable. Coarsened cells are reported only as a possible diagnostic repair, not as confirmation or method selection.
